toolingAssertions.title: security matrix report inventory integrity accepts concrete route paths, query strings, encoded channel params and admin aliases
assertions: A concrete profile request /api/v1/profiles/alice?username=bob is validated against /api/v1/profiles/{username}; query data does not replace the path parameter.
A percent-encoded %23channel path parameter matches its discovered route template.
Concrete current /admin and legacy /api/v1/admin account-role paths match the same exact source template and method.
The previous template-alias plus requestPath form remains readable; generated coverage retains the source template and emits the concrete request path in alias and requestPath.

toolingAssertions.title: security matrix report inventory integrity rejects mismatched routes, methods, unapproved prefixes and traversal aliases
assertions: Mismatched methods, unrelated route prefixes, and route parameters supplied only in query strings are rejected.
Encoded dot segments, encoded separators and malformed percent escapes are rejected.
A concrete alias and its requestPath cannot identify different URL paths.

toolingAssertions.title: security matrix report inventory integrity merges independently executed dimensions conservatively across reordered declarations
assertions: Different declaration ordering and rationale text no longer make equivalent worker claims conflict.
Required wins when current executed claims disagree about applicability.
Only asserted dimensions from exact current executed tests count; a worker PASS label with missing required dimensions remains NOT IMPLEMENTED.

toolingAssertions.title: security matrix report inventory integrity validates checked-in media and channel evidence against their execution manifests without editing them
assertions: The checked-in media.json and channels.json evidence are loaded with all referenced execution manifests and the frozen bundle SHA.

SHA-256 snapshots before and after generation are equal for media.json and channels.json.

inventoryFinding.discoveryBasis: The AST extracts the two registration branches and route/method conditions; metadata key DELETE operations are derived from each actual nested subpath matcher and DELETE branch. Discovery asserts 40 unique route/method pairs and checks dynamic route-template mappings for drift.
inventoryFinding.interpretation: The task's reported hand-list count of 40 agrees with the operations recovered from source, but the hand-list was not used as evidence. Source-operation discovery does not mean those operations have been behaviorally tested.

bugs.details: Literal alias membership rejected concrete dynamic paths and admin IDs. Validation now requires the exact discovered source template and method, then safely matches the concrete path against only the canonical or declared admin alias prefix. Query strings do not participate in routing.
The prior current AST inventory found 36 admin pairs. Four real operations were omitted and are now discovered: two account-registration paths and two metadata-key deletion paths.

Equivalent per-dimension declarations no longer conflict due to object ordering or rationale differences. Required dimensions merge conservatively and PASS still requires current executed evidence covering every required dimension.

coverageGaps: No authorization behavior scenario IDs are asserted by this tooling slice; scenarios is intentionally empty.
The source inventory does not claim successful administrator actions, denials, state changes, events or persistence for the 40 operations.
This slice does not normalize all historical worker evidence or generate the final 339-scenario coverage artifacts.
No application source or frozen bundle was changed or rebuilt.
limitations: Dynamic route matching deliberately rejects encoded path separators, backslashes, dot segments and malformed percent escapes; encoded channel marker %23 is covered.
The worker evidence integration check depends on the supplied /tmp/flarc-matrix-run_01d0e4aeb274 frozen bundle and execution-manifest files being available in this run environment.
